 What do we have to offer? 
Our client offers you more than just a job. You can count on: - A competitive salary appropriate to your experience. - Travel allowance and good fringe benefits. - Working at a growing family business with short lines of communication and a lot of commitment. - Broad development and advancement opportunities. - A job with the prospect of a permanent contract with our client.
